data.name: In the Company of Horses & Wine
data.headline: Interactive Horse Experience and Wine Tasting!
data.description: Join us at Cascade Trails for a one-of-a-kind event blending hands-on equine interaction with a taste of California’s finest wines! Start the experience by connecting with our horses during an interactive session that offers insight into their care, behavior, and unique stories. Once you’ve immersed yourself in the equine world, enjoy a thoughtfully curated tasting from Wiley Wines. Known for their minimal-intervention approach, Wiley Wines crafts single-varietal wines from organically farmed, Northern California vineyards. Each pour celebrates the rugged beauty of California’s landscapes and the pure, unfiltered essence of each grape variety, inspired by founder Phineas Fittipaldi’s passion for wine, nature, and desert charm. This is a perfect pairing for wine and animal lovers seeking an authentic and enriching experience.

meeting_point.address: 6353 Cascade Rd Joshua Tree, CA US 92252

data.what_is_included:
Interactive Equine Experience
	•	Hands-on session with horses.
	•	Insights into horse behavior and care practices at Cascade Trails.
	•	Personalized guidance from knowledgeable staff for a safe and memorable interaction.

Curated Wine Tasting by Wiley Wines
	•	Guided tasting of 3-4 wines, led by Phineas Fittipaldi or a Wiley Wines representative.
	•	Discussion on the minimal-intervention winemaking approach and vineyard stories.
	•	Enjoyment of unique, single-varietal wines from organically farmed Northern California vineyards.


Access to Beautiful Cascade Trails Ranch
	•	Time for photos, mingling, and taking in the desert landscape and natural beauty.
	•	The chance to purchase wine or small keepsakes as mementos of the day.
data.what_is_not_included:
•	Transportation

	•	Carrots for the horses or grapes for the goats. Available for purchase at the ranch.
data.cancellation_notes: Cancellation Policy: Tickets are non-refundable, but can be transferred to another guest if needed.
data.booking_notes:
Thank you for securing your spot for our upcoming event at Cascade Trails with Wiley Wines! We’re excited to welcome you to a memorable afternoon filled with equine experiences and delicious wines.

Here are the details of your reservation:

Date: 12/7/24
Time: 2:30 PM - 4:30 PM
Location: Cascade Trails Mustang Sanctuary

What’s Included:

	•	Hands-on interactive experience with our horses.
	•	Guided wine tasting with Phineas Fittipaldi of Wiley Wines.
	•	Light bites paired with the tasting.
	•	Refreshments upon arrival.

What’s Not Included:

	•	Additional wine purchases (bottles available for sale).
	•	Keepsake items or merchandise.
	•	Trail rides or other equine activities beyond the scheduled session.
	•	Transportation to and from the event.

Additional Information:

	•	Arrival: Please plan to arrive 10-15 minutes early for check-in.
	•	Attire: Comfortable, closed-toe shoes and sun protection, as the event is outdoors.
	•	Cancellation Policy: Tickets are non-refundable, but can be transferred to another guest if needed.

If you have any questions or need assistance, please don’t hesitate to reach out. We look forward to seeing you for a fantastic afternoon of horses and wine!

Warm regards,
Marissa
Cascade Trails Mustang Sanctuary
